name: Radical politics
notAnIdeology: Radical politics is a disposition (an intent to change society's fundamental principles by root-level reform or revolution) that Wikipedia says applies across left and right, from anarchists and communists to the radical right, so it has no shared set of positions to answer statements with; its one doctrinal strand, the late-18th to mid-19th-century Radicals, is already covered by the existing audit classical-radicalism.
